capabilities: Reuse a saved file inventory to open the vault sooner
Verify cached file lists in the background after startup
Cut work from workspace restoration and large plugin file reads
Compare local startup times across launches
Fall back to normal behavior when verification fails
extras: Uses internal Obsidian APIs and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Only affects Android; caches no note contents and contacts only localhost. Search and query results may be incomplete during background verification, and external apps' writes are not locked.
problem: Obsidian can take a long time to open large vaults on Android because it rebuilds the file list and restores the workspace on every startup.
summary: Startup performance plugin that opens large Android vaults faster by reusing a cached file list, workspace display hints, and background file verification.
